BE10 : BUTTERFLY DAMPER VALVES

Leakage Performance Up to 99.95%
Temperature Range -25°C to 825°C

KEY HIGHLIGHTS

PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Bellator BE10 Series Butterfly Damper Valves are designed for reliable isolation and flow control of air, flue gases, and process media in industrial ducting systems. Manufactured with heavy-duty fabricated construction, these dampers offer smooth operation, dependable sealing performance, and long operational life under demanding service conditions.

AUTOMATION OPTIONS

Available Actuation Systems

PNEUMATIC

Heavy duty pneumatic actuator with positioners, solenoid valves & limit switches

ELECTRIC

Motorized quarter-turn/multi-turn actuators for modulating & ON/OFF control

HYDRAULIC

Electro-hydraulic power units with fast trip fail-safe accumulators

MANUAL

Hand lever and precision bevel/worm gearboxes with limit switches
